manuscript_prose.section1_title: 1. Comparative Scope Across Blattodea Outgroups, Relictual Termites & Higher Termitidae
manuscript_prose.section1_p1: Termites (Blattodea: Isoptera) evolved obligate eusociality, soldier morphology, endogenous wood-cellulose hydrolysis, and fungal agriculture across 238 million years of Mesozoic and Cenozoic radiation from Cryptocercus wood-roach ancestors through basal Mastotermitidae, Archotermopsidae, Kalotermitidae, subterranean Rhinotermitidae (Coptotermes, Reticulitermes, Heterotermes), and higher Termitidae (Macrotermitinae, Apicotermitinae, Termitinae, Cubitermitinae, Nasutitermitinae, Syntermitinae).
manuscript_prose.section1_p2: In Version 5.0.0, all 64 stratified Blattodea and Isoptera slots ([A]-[G]) run through the generalized declarative bio-suite pipeline, pairing Invertebrate Mitochondrial Code 5 organelle locus phasing and authentic unphased mitogenome Raw-0Beaker controls with Universal Standard Code 1 single-family GH9, JHE, Hsp70, and Clan-4 CYP4G15/CYP4C selection tests.
manuscript_prose.section2_title: 2. Per-Locus BIC ModelTest, Edge-Linked Proportional Partitioning & >=80% Supermatrix Gate
manuscript_prose.section3_title: 3. 64-Species Multispecies Coalescent Species Tree, ABBA-BABA & 32-Chain RuNIE Audit
manuscript_prose.section4_title: 4. Homogeneous Lignocellulase, Endocrine, Chaperone & Clan-4 P450 Selection (GH9, JHE, Hsp70 & CYP4G15 on 1TQN)
manuscript_prose.section4_body: Across verified Universal Code 1 arthropod nuclear alignments passing strict pre-MSA motif rules and post-MSA codon row auditing, 61-state Goldman-Yang codon models quantify purifying constraint and episodic diversification across homogeneous GH9 beta-1,4-endoglucanases (FAM-01), juvenile hormone esterases and FE4 carboxylesterases (FAM-02), Hsp70/Hsc70 ATPase chaperones (FAM-03), and microsomal Clan-4 CYP4G15/CYP4C monooxygenases (FAM-04) threaded onto PDB 1TQN (2.05 A) with the conserved I-helix dioxygen groove and proximal Cys442 heme-thiolate coordination.
manuscript_prose.section5_title: 5. Cross-Regional COX1 vs. Single-Subunit 16S LSU rRNA (4Ne) Skylines & Stage 3C Haplotype Networks
discussion_paragraphs: Integrating 64 Blattodea and Isoptera taxa across basal wood-feeding lineages, subterranean Rhinotermitidae, and specialized higher Termitidae confirms robust deep-node congruence between edge-linked partitioned RY3 maximum likelihood and 64-species ASTRAL-equivalent quartet multispecies coalescence.

Separating mixed Stage 4 nuclear gene sets into homogeneous GH9 endoglucanase, JHE carboxylesterase, Hsp70 chaperone, and Clan-4 CYP4G15/CYP4C alignments eliminates cross-fold homology noise and confirms 100% proximal Cys-loop and I-helix retention across the S1 cytochrome P450 benchmark.

Restoring authentic unphased circular mitogenomes to Regime 4 Raw-0Beaker resolves the v3.0.0 bootstrap inversion cleanly while single-subunit 16S LSU rRNA E-INS-i cohorts (L2 and L5) contrast buffered ribosomal diversity against Pleistocene contractions and maritime bridgehead bottlenecks in Coptotermes and Reticulitermes.
manuscript_prose.abstract_context: Resolving the evolutionary transition from wood-feeding cockroaches to eusocial termites requires separating deep blattodean phylogeny from compositional saturation while tracking endogenous lignocellulase and detoxification evolution.
manuscript_prose.executive_summary_lead: traces the global radiation and lignocellulase evolution of eusocial termites
manuscript_prose.latex_intro: Blattodea and Isoptera lineages span Xylophagodea wood-roach outgroups [A] through Nasutitermitinae [G], analyzed under Genetic Codes 5 and 1 in Version 5.0.0.
